mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here, because together, we're about to step into a world where ambition burns bright, innovation pushes limits, and fortunes can vanish in the blink of an eye. Imagine a company that promised to change everything—dazzling Wall Street, shaking up the energy industry, and making us all believe in a future that seemed just within reach. But what happens when that bright promise hides secrets? What if behind the scenes, risk-taking and secrecy quietly eat away at success? That’s exactly the story Bethany McLean shares with us in The Smartest Guys in the Room: The Amazing Rise and Scandalous Fall of Enron. As we peel back the curtain, we’ll discover how a culture of self-delusion and unchecked ambition led not just to breathtaking highs, but also to a dramatic, unforgettable fall. We’ll see how leadership decisions, personal motivations, and the culture inside one of America’s most celebrated companies all collided—with consequences no one could ignore. So, if you’re curious about what really happens behind closed doors in corporate America, and what we can all learn from Enron’s rise and collapse, you’re in the right place. Let’s explore this journey together—and uncover the powerful lessons waiting for us in this incredible story.
